class.name: MaszynaMoverRailVehicleMasterController
class.description: [RailVehicleMasterController] simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]): its configuration is written into the vehicle's Mover and its live values are read straight from it. Created by the FIZ import for a vehicle [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] simulates; everything else reaches it through [RailVehicleMasterController].

method.name: get_main_delayed
method.description: Whether the master controller waits on its first position for the line contactors ([code]DelayCtrlFlag[/code]).
